# Mama's Java Cafe

> Mama's Java Cafe in Nolensville, TN serves flavored coffee roasted by Mark Hall, tea, pastries and snacks baked by Melissa.

- Phone: (615) 776-5282
- Email: mamasjavatn@yahoo.com
- Based in: Nolensville, TN
- Serves: Nolensville, TN
- Hours: Mon to Fri 6:30 am to 3 pm; Sat 7 am to 2 pm; Sun 8 am to 1 pm
- Website: https://www.example.com/
- Free quote: https://www.example.com/quote/

## Services

- [Flavored coffee](https://www.example.com/services/flavored-coffee/): Brewed coffee with a nut, chocolate, fruit or dessert flavor added.
- [Pastries](https://www.example.com/services/pastries/): Baked sweet goods such as rolls, buns, scones and danishes.
- [Tea](https://www.example.com/services/tea/): Leaves steeped in hot water, served black, green or herbal.
